profile.headline: Software Engineer at Rothe Development Inc.
profile.jobTitle: Software Engineer at Rothe Development Inc.
profile.summary:
Creative and efficient Software Developer with 10+ years of experience in ASP.NET web application powered by .NET framework technology, jQuery and Microsoft SQL Server.

Proficient in ASP.NET application, MS SQL Server Database Administration, Software Agile Methods (VersionOne)

Expert in converting MS Access applications to .NET web applications

positions.title: Software Engineer at Rothe Development Inc.
Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed the award-winning .NET web application to consolidate multiple disparate systems and increase the overall efficiency by saving customers’ time and cost significantly.

Transitioned MS Access application seamlessly and successfully to the Web application utilizing ASP.NET technology and Microsoft SQL Server.

Responsible for planning, design, coding, testing, documentation and implementation of the cost-saving incident reporting database to track process or procedural issues, then drive improvements to increase efficiency in the Mission Control Center. 

Integrated other NASA facility scheduling and anomaly tracking databases into customized web application to further enhance the system usefulness. 

Re-engineered the system architecture and led the .NET programming team to successfully develop and launch Mission Reconfiguration Request (MRR) tool that exceeds the customer’s satisfaction.

Increased availability of metrics by developing effective SQL stored procedures to analyze data and generating accurate reports for the managers to present to NASA at daily meetings
